note: Skill descriptions and per-level effects compiled from the Escape from Tarkov community wiki, except where marked 'source: game config' (taken from the game's globals/hideout settings as mirrored by the SPT project, Aug 2026). BSG changes skills between patches and does not publish the client-side effects, so treat the rest as approximate. When game data is loaded, only skills tarkov.dev lists as active in the game are shown. To correct values, copy this file to data/skills.json and edit it; the tracker prefers that copy.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.description: Increases stamina and how fast it recovers, and reduces breathlessness.
skills.levelUp: Running, sprinting and moving while overweight.
elite: Breathing no longer depends on energy

skills.name: Strength
skills.description: Increases carry weight, sprint speed, jump height, throw distance and melee power.
skills.levelUp: Sprinting, jumping and moving while overweight, throwing grenades, melee hits.
elite: +10% carry weight
Melee attacks deal extra damage

skills.name: Vitality
skills.description: Reduces the chance of bleeding and of limbs being destroyed by damage.
skills.levelUp: Taking damage, having a bleeding or a destroyed limb.

effects.name: Survival chance from blacked limb damage

elite: No more damage from bleedings

skills.name: Health
skills.description: Reduces fracture chance, slows energy and hydration drain, speeds up recovery.
elite: Damage to an already destroyed limb is reduced
Energy and hydration drain while overweight is reduced

skills.name: Stress Resistance
skills.description: Reduces pain, tremor and the effects of stress on aim.
skills.levelUp: Receiving damage and being in pain.
elite: Pain no longer causes tremor

skills.name: Metabolism
skills.description: Improves the energy and hydration you get from food and drinks and slows how fast they drain.

effects.name: Energy and hydration from food and drink

elite: Physical skills no longer degrade

skills.name: Immunity
skills.description: Reduces poisoning and negative stimulant effects.
skills.levelUp: Being poisoned and taking stimulants with negative effects.
elite: Immune to some negative stimulant effects

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Increases hearing distance and how far you hear loot.
elite: Loot items around you are highlighted when searching

skills.name: Intellect

skills.levelUp: Examining items and repairing weapons and armor.
elite: Items no longer need to be examined

skills.name: Attention
skills.description: Speeds up looting and raises the chance of finding rare items.

effects.name: Chance of finding more valuable loot
